Appreciate the quick follow-up and the detailed deck. Brightleaf is excited by the performance benchmarks, but we need to stay within the board-approved procurement envelope for FY29. Two asks from my side:

Thanks for the run. Two quick items from my side before we involve legal:

1) Can you confirm forecasted expansion assumptions embedded in the model? I want to see the 24-month cohort against the 12-month discount (are we assuming 40% upsell in year 2?).
2) Margin guardrails: instead of 25%, I’d support a constrained exception at 20% + $50k onboarding, conditional on a short-term SLA credit structure and a capped onboarding drawdown tied to milestones (kickoff, M1, handover). That reduces downside and keeps us inside commercial thresholds that don’t require Board notice.

If Priya confirms the expansion basis and can accept the milestone drawdown approach, I’m comfortable recommending a CFO sign-off at 22% (compromise). Naomi — can you confirm if Finance is OK with a 22% exception with the $50k onboarding cap and milestone release? If so, we’ll route a one-page approval memo and get DocuSign ready.

Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales

3) Send DocuSign packet to Aaron for signature; don’t execute until legal confirms SOW language.

I’m attaching the signed approval memo (approval_memo_naomi.pdf). I will not approve any higher concession without a formal business case to the CFO.
